title: Mirror Vault artifacts and enforce bootstrap access revocation
expected_outcome: A digest- and SHA-verified Vault chart/toolchain mirror path and a staged prepare-deploy-revoke contract prevent private Vault bootstrap unless the temporary EKS policy is removed and verified.
constraints: No Vault init, unseal, secret data access, public endpoint, or workload deployment.
Only approved digest-pinned OCI images and the SHA-verified Vault chart 0.31.0 may be mirrored.
The EKS cluster-admin association exists only for the deploy stage and its absence is verified in the revoke stage.

external_actions: publish only approved artifact copies to private ECR after plan review
